objects.name: The Staked Light
objects.vInscr: Driven into the bog on a pole of bone. The bog is slowly pulling it under.

objects.name: Chalked Waystone
objects.vInscr: Kindled by pilgrims. Touch it, and every lit waystone on the Hide knows your step.

landmarks.name: She Who Keeps the Low Light
landmarks.inscription: She kneels where the road went under. The lantern is filled each dusk; no one has seen by whom.

landmarks.name: The Unmirroring Ring
landmarks.inscription: Seven stones for Ysse, who could not bear her own face. The water keeps her wish: lean over it, and it shows you only the dark.

landmarks.name: The Hill of Spent Prayers
landmarks.inscription: A thousand asked, and the little god drank every flame. Some still burn. Someone has not yet stopped asking.

landmarks.name: The Belfry of the Low Water
landmarks.inscription: It rang for the flood, and the flood answered. On still nights the bell is heard beneath the fen, counting something.
